name: printshop-companion
description: PrintShop Companion — Android app that integrates the web consumer app with native camera, UPI intent, secure storage, and local notifications.

scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.release: npm run build:apk && npm run sign:apk
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && cd android && ./gradlew clean || true
